rulings.Calendar Matter: ACCOUNTING PETITION RE: Accounting #2, Report
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 10/27/26. (No earlier availability.) Issue(s) necessitating continuance: (1) No proposed order has been lodged or received by the assigned examiner. [LRSF 14.7 A. and 14.59 E.] (2) No proof of service of notice has been filed. (3) Notice must have attached to it the procedures for how to make a remote appearance by Zoom and CourtCall, as well as remote public access, as set out at https://sf.courts.ca.gov/divisions/probate-court. (5) The ending balance in the second amended first accounting showed $72,504.50. This one begins with $72,504.05. (6) Proof of the reimbursement of the remaining $30 from the inadvertent transfer has not been filed. (7) Under what authority was the attorney paid legal fees for "educational and disability-rights advocacy" representation? Please file invoices. How did the services benefit the beneficiary? (8) Reimbursements to the fiduciaries must indicate who the original payees were. Please provide a proposed order and courtesy copies of any papers filed to address these issues to the assigned examiner by 10/13/26. Examiner continuances are final and not subject to contest under LRSF 14.10 B. (For interim accounts, only the statement verifying the ending balance needs to be filed.)

[LRSF 14.1 C.6.] (2) If the surviving spouse's two sons are her successors-in-interest (no probate estate has been opened for her and she did not have a trust, etc.), their 13100 affidavits must be filed. Only separate property passes 1/3 to the surviving spouse's issue and 2/3 to decedent's four issue.)

rulings.Case Title: IN THE MATTER OF THE IN RE THE ERIC AND JANE DIAZ TRUST, DATED AUGUST
rulings.Calendar Matter: Petition For Confirmation Of Trust Assets (Probate Code Section 850 A 3
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 10/27/26. (No earlier availability.) Issue(s) necessitating continuance: (1) An amended petition requires the same notice as the pleading it amends. A petition filed pursuant to Probate Code Section 850 requires 30 days' notice. [CRC 7.53(a) and Prob. C. Sect. 851.] (2) The notice must show the complete title of the pleading to be heard, here an AMENDED petition. (3) Notice is defective if mailed before the filing of the pleading requiring notice. [LRSF 14.14 A.] "Filing" means when the pleading requiring notice appears on the Court's register of actions and becomes publicly viewable. The amended petition was not e-filed until 8/26/26. The amended petition has not yet been fully reviewed, as no courtesy copy has been received by the assigned examiner. Deadline is 10/13/26 to provide the assigned examiner a courtesy copy of the amended petition and any supporting papers. Examiner continuances are final and not subject to contest under LRSF 14.10 B.

rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF GREGORIO MENDOZA CHAVEZ
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR PROBATE OF WILL AND FOR LETTERS TESTAMENTARY
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 09/29/2026. Issues necessitating continuance: 1) A proposed nonresident personal representative will be required to post a bond to protect California creditors, even if the will waives bond. A declaration or attachment to the petition setting forth in detail the anticipated liabilities of the decedent and claims against the estate will be used by the Court to determine the amount of the bond, but in no event will the bond be less than $20,000 (LRSF 14.16.F). 2) When second generation or more distant heirs are listed, the deceased ancestor(s) through whom they take (or would have taken) must be named, the relationship(s) to the decedent stated, and the date(s) of death specified (LRSF 14.18.C.3). Please address the above issues and deliver courtesy copies of all further filings to this examiner no later than 09/22/2026 to avoid additional continuance.
